model: NOAA GEFS v12, 0.25 deg (AWS Open Data)
climatology: ERA5 (WeatherBench2) 2010-2019, every 3 days, per calendar month and UTC hour
detection: z(wind) >= 2 and z(MSLP) <= -2 and wind >= 17 m/s, >= 6 cells; tracks of >= 2 steps

field.note: ensemble-mean 10 m wind speed, all members, every 24 h
